nodes.label: wp.php WordPress bootstrap and fixture helpers
Why harness cleanup never globs the backup directory
nodes.rationale: harness_cleanup() resolves and deletes backups only through the manifest recorded on each attachment's own OptimizationLog row, never by scanning the backup directory, because a previous harness's cleanup used glob(BackupManager::root().'/@*/@*/@*') and destroyed 54 real user backups covering 228 original files.
